title: Investigate overcount during rollup path for throttle shim when route aliases and org overrides mix
creator: Priya Patel
description: Summary: Production alerts show transient billing spikes and duplicate-metering events for a subset of small-duration streaming requests. Root cause appears to be the rollup/aggregation path in the throttle shim that runs during shard rebalancing and route alias resolution. When an org-level override exists and a route is referenced by multiple aliases, the rollup path double-counts a small fraction of requests during epoch handoff and lease renewal. This ticket captures investigation notes, repro steps, a hypothesis, and remediation plan.
impact: Observed doubled token meter increments for ~0.2% of requests across several enterprise customers during our last two shard rebalances; correlated with small windowed-rate policies and per-org overrides. Customers saw unexpected bill spikes and several incidents escalated to SRE/support.
steps_to_reproduce: Deploy a test tenant with an org override policy (per_org_slab) and a parent per-route policy with alias routing.
Start high-frequency short-stream requests (avg 75ms) across two aliases that map to the same canonical route while running a controlled shard rebalance (simulate lease revoke + reassign).
Collect meter events (edge ingest) and compare per-key token increments vs canonical route accounting.
Reproduce spikes by toggling fast lease timeouts and forcing split-second policy-cache refreshes.
Capture runtime traces with throttle-shim span and rollup path enabled (trace-id header) for ambiguous windows.
observed_logs: 2026-03-09T14:11:02Z WARN throttle-shim rollup: ambiguous-merge org=acct-78 route=chat-std alias=[cli,v1] epoch=542 lease_reassign=true
2026-03-09T14:11:02Z INFO meter-emit key=cred-abc increment=120 window=1s shard=shard-22 source=fastpath
2026-03-09T14:11:02Z INFO meter-emit key=cred-abc increment=120 window=1s shard=shard-23 source=rollup
hypothesis: During a shard handoff the throttle shim rollup path may re-evaluate route alias membership without deduplicating upstream fastpath emits. If an org override exists, the policy-adapter returns a per-org slab ID that is transiently different during cache refresh, causing the rollup to treat the same logical request as two distinct meterable events (fastpath + rollup) and increment both. The timing window is narrow (sub-second) and is amplified when lease revocations and alias lookups occur concurrently.
proposed_fix: 1) Ensure rollup path checks a recent-ingest tombstone and deduplicates events by stable canonical key (org+route+request-id) before emitting increments. 2) Add a short-lived idempotency token to meter events emitted by fastpath so rollup can skip duplicates. 3) Update policy-adapter cache invalidation to propagate stable slab IDs during lease handoffs rather than ephemeral values. 4) Add unit/integration tests simulating lease reassign and alias resolution race.
work_items: WIP: add idempotency token to fastpath meter-emits — eng/ingest#branch/fp-idempotency
Implement dedupe in rollup path and add metric for deduped_count — eng/rate-limiter#PR-719
Adjust policy-adapter to pin slab IDs for 2s during in-flight handoffs — eng/policy#PR-134
Create integration test harness that replays lease reassign scenarios — eng/testinfra#ticket-482
mitigation: Short-term: increase rollup suppression window to 2s for affected shards via feature flag (rollup.dedupe.window=2000ms).
Customer-facing: notify impacted customers with reconciliation and offer manual credit where overcharge observed.
Operational: add Grafana alert for 'duplicate_meter_emits_rate' and increase sampling on throttle-shim spans.
bespoke_notes: This bug only surfaces when three conditions align: 1) alias routing in use, 2) org-level override present, 3) shard lease churning. We should instrument how many customers match all three conditions as a gating metric for rollout urgency.
rollout_plan: Patch rollout: rollout v2.4.1 to canary (10% of shards) with rollup.dedupe.window=enabled, observe duplicate_meter_emits_rate for 24h, then 50% for 6h, full rollout if <0.001% duplicates. Post-deploy reconciliation job to retroactively stitch meter events for affected windows and issue credits.
qa_criteria: Integration test demonstrates no duplicate meter increments under simulated lease reassigns for 10k requests.
Canary shows deduped_count > 0 and duplicate_meter_emits_rate reduced to baseline.
No regression in latency P50/P95 for throttle-shim path (max 5% increase allowed).
blockers: Need a short-term feature flag plumbing in runtime control plane — infra dependency.
Policy-adapter change requires a release coordination with Dedicated rollout team.
